message.title: Invitation to OKEA's third quarter conference call, 3 November 2026
message.body:
(Trondheim, 23 October 2026) OKEA ASA (OSE: OKEA) will publish its financial
report for the third quarter of 2026 on Tuesday 3 November at 06:00 CET. A
trading update summarising key figures for the quarter will be published on
Tuesday 27 October at 06:00 CET.

A presentation of the results and a Q&A session will be held on Tuesday 3
November through a webcast and audio conference starting 10:00 CET. The
presentation will be held by Svein J. Liknes(CEO) and Birte Norheim (CFO).
The webcastcan be followed at www.okea.no
orOKEA Webcast Q3 2026
(royalcast.com) (https://qcnl.tv/p/9i4qAo4FtWGLbl1DJlgvCg)

About OKEA
OKEA ASA is a leading mid- and late-life operator on the Norwegian continental
shelf (NCS). OKEA finds value where others divest and has an ambitious strategy
built on growth, value creation and capital discipline.

OKEA is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange (OSE:OKEA)

More information at www.okea.no
